name: Fuel Economy Gas Mileage MPG MCP
description: EPA city, highway and combined MPG, MPGe, EV range and annual fuel cost for any car by year, make and model from fueleconomy.gov, plus side-by-side comparisons. Tools: fuel_economy_lookup, fuel_economy_compare, fuel_cost_calculator, fuel_economy_models. Hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint, no account or API key.
author: theluckystrike
